claim: Both era-arithmetic functions are guarded by the same two static_asserts, requiring numeric_limits<unsigned>::digits >= 18 and numeric_limits<int>::digits >= 20, so the port must reject any target whose int or unsigned is narrower than 32 bits; the guards are about intermediate headroom for doe = yoe*365 + yoe/4 - yoe/100 + doy, not about the result overflowing.
